QF.id: VIII Introduction to Clearing and Settlement System_30

question.text: Under physical settlement of stock derivatives, a trader with a short futures position at expiry must:

answer.text: Deliver the underlying shares through the physical settlement process by ensuring the required shares are available in demat for delivery
Pay only the cash difference between futures and spot price
Roll over the position to the next month automatically
Pay a penalty and square off the position

explanation.text: The Logic: A short stock futures position at expiry results in a sell/security deliverable position. Under the physical settlement process the short client must deliver the underlying shares — operationally this means the shares are transferred from the client's demat to the depository pool account per the clearing corporation's settlement schedule. The Trap: Physical settlement means actual delivery of shares, not cash adjustment. Positions do not automatically roll over — the trader must actively roll over before expiry if they want to continue the exposure. Note: The same physical settlement framework applies to ITM stock options at expiry: short side delivers, long side takes delivery and pays the settlement amount.
